scope: Whole working-tree integration cut: direct paged custody, CAP0 data observer, paged Admin review, index request/review joins and custody memory split; no installed index run or native C activation
implementation: Paged C data uses direct-addressed immutable storage locations with sealed slot digests, bounded control cells and prewrite index reservations
A worker consumes those fixed slots for direct publication; a private installed reader verifies the completed C cut, and the cold verifier binds the logical review digest exactly as planning does
A query-only CAP0 data observer admits only the fixed C peer under its own AppArmor profile and systemd unit
Paged custody review, bootstrap and reconcile run only under an original Admin governance grant and effect journal
Index request and scope-proposal commands return DATA; the workspace index review reads current C state but never executes a build effect

Fixed custody memory split under a 512 MiB Index lease: worker and C each have a 256 MiB hard ceiling; only Manager after real admission raises the C slice from its ordinary 128M bound, and lowering retains the lease until C drained; custody, observer and slice units deny swap
PDF remains the only native office driver; the portable workbook is a pure data module without I/O

Test-only seam: inside the verified disposable CLI container with no TPM device node, the publication fixture observes an empty fixed-handle set instead of opening a TPM; it never substitutes an enrolled Admin or release anchor
